exclude_from_strategy.YM: Duplicate Dow exposure; retain older ZD series.
exclude_from_strategy.EC: Instrument identity/classification unresolved; omit from strategy rather than assign an unverified class.

base.funding: Primary: zero-interest synthetic futures-price-return proxy. RF-added results are conditional fully collateralized sensitivities, not verified vendor total returns.
base.signal: Sign of the sum of the preceding 12 monthly price returns; scaling that window by the same current positive risk estimate leaves its sign unchanged. Zero means flat.
base.execution: Primary monthly endpoint execution is idealized: history through t-1 determines t exposure at the prior endpoint. A two-month information lag tests one extra full month of execution delay.
base.missing_data: Require complete trailing signal/risk windows. Never select assets using current/future returns. Raise on any nonzero held exposure with missing realized return; do not fill or silently drop P&L months.
base.cost_model: Illustrative linear bps per absolute traded notional divided by beginning-month NAV, including initial entry, drift-adjusted monthly rebalancing, RL-to-ER source transition and final liquidation. No bid/ask, market impact, margin, tax or contract-roll cost history is available.
base.baseline: 12-month trend, trailing correlation-aware risk model, 2% volatility floor, 3x gross cap, 10% forecast risk ceiling, +/-10% trading band; portfolio controls are in config/risk_config.json.
base.benchmark: STATIC: always long, using the same instrument eligibility, risk model, limits, trading band, and costs; its own forecast determines scaling.

risk.cost_convention: Effective aggregate trading-cost proxy in bps per unit of absolute one-way traded notional / beginning-period NAV; turnover is not divided by two. Entries, source close/open trades and terminal liquidation are charged. Regular expiry-roll activity is not yet modeled separately.
risk.trade_rule: Existing same-direction positions: retain within relative band, otherwise trade to nearest edge. New entries, zero targets and sign changes execute at target. Hard risk and exposure limits override the band.
risk.limit_timing: Monthly decision points, after beginning-of-month trading costs; capital and forecasts can change between rebalances. Proportional reductions only; do not enlarge positions to reach the risk ceiling.
risk.lecture_source: ORIE5260 Lecture 5, slides 9, 12–16, 26–27 and 36 (reference only; not a runtime input)

source_selection.rule: RL until ER has 36 consecutive observed monthly returns ending at least two months before the holding month, then ER permanently. Never choose source from current realized availability.

risk.autocorrelation_hac: At return lag k, use k Bartlett HAC lags on calendar-spaced scores, with n/(n-2) correction and t(n-2) intervals.
risk.risk_model_note: correlation_shrinkage (0.5) is the rolling covariance baseline, kept as the reference; risk_model.correlation_shrinkage is the DCC-GARCH value (notebooks/risk_model_estimators.ipynb: with the rescale the level matters little, 0.05 to 0.1 recommended). rescale: past-only calibration scale, window and minimum in months. Set risk_model to {"type": "rolling"} for the baseline.
risk.trend_signal_note: notebooks/trend_measures.ipynb, section 5 and the summary table. In-sample class-portfolio rankings, not validated out of sample. COMM, FI and EQ keep the baseline 12-month sum; FX averages a 3-month and a 12-month sum, a blend that was not itself in the notebook's grid.
